facts.fact: The Department of Basic Education says it records learner enrolment data through LURITS, with 13,596,869 learners recorded for 2025.
The Department says LURITS holds learner-level records for 13,596,869 learners in 2025, those without ID numbers captured under alternative unique identifiers.
